title: Graces
description:
Lord Jesus
Be Our Guest
And Let
These Gifts
To Us
Be Blest.
Amen
Bless Us, O Lord
and these Thy gifts
which we are about
to receive from Thy bounty.
Through Christ our Lord.
Amen
